name: Reviewer Loop
description:
A four-step recipe for any "draft, critique, revise, publish" pattern.

The workflow exists for cases where a first draft is not enough: briefs,
announcements, reports, specs, and other artifacts that need an explicit
review pass before they are considered done.

Phases:

1. Draft (writer) — identify the deliverable path and acceptance criteria,
   then write the first complete file.
2. Critique (reviewer) — review the file against the criteria and route
   either to revision or publish.
3. Revise (writer) — address the named critique with a real file edit, then
   loop back to critique.
4. Publish (writer) — stamp the final summary only after reviewer approval.

The evaluate step is the gate. It defaults back to revision and must never
route to publish while a criterion is unmet. The safe failure mode is another
targeted revision, not an early DONE.

steps.name: Draft
steps.description: Produce the first cut of the requested artifact and make the review target explicit.
steps.prompt: Create the first complete draft of the requested artifact. Before writing, identify the deliverable path, audience, and 4-6 acceptance criteria in task notes. Then write the draft with the appropriate file-writing tool. Do not ask for critique until a real draft exists. When the draft is written, add a short task note naming the path and the criteria it is intended to satisfy, then call `advance_task_step({ ref, stepId: "draft", next: "evaluate" })`.

steps.name: Critique
steps.description: Review the draft against the criteria and route either to revision or publish.
steps.prompt: Act as the reviewer. Read the deliverable and the acceptance criteria from task notes. Write a concrete critique to task notes with PASS/FAIL for each criterion and no vague style advice. If every criterion passes, call `advance_task_step({ ref, stepId: "evaluate", next: "publish" })`; publish is the finish route. If any criterion fails, write the specific gaps and call `advance_task_step({ ref, stepId: "evaluate", next: "revise" })`. Never route to publish or finish while a criterion is unmet.

steps.name: Revise
steps.description: Address the named critique without redesigning unrelated parts.
steps.prompt: Revise the deliverable to address exactly the critique in task notes. Preserve criteria that already passed. Make a real file edit; a prose promise is not enough. After editing, write a short task note listing which critique items were fixed and call `advance_task_step({ ref, stepId: "revise", next: "evaluate" })` so the reviewer can check the revision.

steps.name: Publish
steps.description: Stamp the final summary after reviewer approval.
steps.prompt: The reviewer approved the artifact. Write a one-paragraph DONE summary to task notes naming the final deliverable path and the acceptance criteria that passed. Then report DONE.
